name: A Donation of Silk
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 60, 8,250 XP in all.
